items.source: Interface to be implemented by objects that expose CacheStatistics identified by cacheName. Typically used by cache writers.
items.translation: 由对象实现的接口，这些对象通过 `cacheName` 标识并暴露了 CacheStatistics。通常由缓存写入器使用。

items.source: Obtain snapshot of the captured statistics. May return a statistics object whose counters are zero if there are no statistics for cacheName.
items.translation: 获取捕获的统计信息的快照。如果 `cacheName` 没有统计信息，则可能返回一个计数器为零的统计对象。
